d:
A hijack note was found inside the lavatory of an Air India Kolkata-Mumbai flight at Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport (NSCBI), Kolkata, this morning. Following this, the aircraft was moved to the isolation bay this morning shortly before take-off. Security agencies immediately reached the spot and initiated checks as per standard operating procedures (SOP). The situation is being assessed, and further details are awaited.
